groups.rationale: Reviewed: trace-schema.json regenerated by generate_schema.exs from current production literals (adds the terminal.viewer_refused gateway/attach reasons and vocabulary already in source); the trace vocabulary contract and its documented derivation are unchanged.

Reviewed: Notifications Device/Delivery PaperTrail tables join the existing lifecycle expiry list enforced by PaperTrailPolicyTest; chapters do not enumerate version tables. Viewer gateway refusals emit the catalogued terminal.viewer_refused event with closed reasons the log filter allows. Covenant coverage.json regenerated from a passing 42/42 run. No documented behaviour changes.

Reviewed the merge of trunk b80bb7cb (Android guest capability and shared display relay) and f959ea25 (commit attribution copy) into the Mila integration: the Android display registry joins Marshall's supervision tree beside the Mila, Susan and Notifications work without overlap; the 28 account catalogs drop trunk's stray duplicate msgstr under Commit attribution so gettext compiles; ssh and account POTs re-extracted for shifted line references.
Reviewed Phase 2 fixes: no Lilly source changed; chapter 19 change is the account-page approval scope correction.

Reviewed Phase 2 fixes: the Porsche invalid-boot probe expects the seven base children chapter 08 documents (adding Porsche.Watchers and Porsche.Terminal.Attachments); Porsche POTs re-extracted after formatting; Susan tests now build canonical 22-character collapse ids and sign the domain-separated SusanPoke message, and the test database user falls back to USER like Marshall's.

Reviewed: the terminal viewer now reports gateway and attach refusals (gateway_session, gateway_unavailable, gateway_ticket, stream_unavailable, attach_timeout, attach_refused) through the existing catalogued terminal.viewer_refused event and log-filter allowlist, and the porsche-terminal fleet scenario opens its session with Porsche terminal new instead of the standalone operator; refusal behaviour and authority are unchanged.
Reviewed Phase 2 fixes: one @cc directive per comment block in Porsche.Runner and Mila's terminal controller so check_contracts passes; chapter 19 approval scope corrected.
